author: Karl Rock
description:
During my travels in Pakistan, I witnessed something that genuinely surprised me.

A man pushed in front of me in a queue at McDonald's. I decided to let it go, but before I could say anything, an employee stepped in and told him to wait his turn because I had been there first.

It might seem like a small thing, but after years of travelling across India & Pakistan, I honestly wasn't expecting it.

Sometimes it's the little everyday moments that leave the biggest impression.
title: Pakistani Worker Stood Up for Me
